# Correlation matrix for fitted params

```{r}
cormat <- round(cor(AsymLR.ParamDf[2:5]),2)
library(reshape2)
melted_cormat <- melt(cormat)
  get_lower_tri<-function(cormat){
    cormat[upper.tri(cormat)] <- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
  # Get upper triangle of the correlation matrix
  get_upper_tri <- function(cormat){
    cormat[lower.tri(cormat)]<- NA
    return(cormat)
  }
reorder_cormat <- function(cormat){
# Use correlation between variables as distance
dd <- as.dist((1-cormat)/2)
hc <- hclust(dd)
cormat <-cormat[hc$order, hc$order]
}

upper_tri <- get_upper_tri(cormat)
# Melt the correlation matrix
melted_cormat <- melt(upper_tri, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a ggheatmap
ggheatmap <- ggplot(melted_cormat, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value))+
 geom_tile(color = "white")+
 scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", 
   midpoint = 0, limit = c(-1,1), space = "Lab", 
    name="Pearson\nCorrelation") +
  theme_minimal()+ # minimal theme
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, 
    size = 25, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text( 
    size = 25) )+
 coord_fixed()

greekLab <- c(expression(alpha[p]), expression(alpha[n]), expression(phi), expression(beta) )

ggheatmap + 
geom_text(aes(Var2, Var1, label = value), color = "black", size = 4) +
theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  legend.justification = c(1, 0),
  legend.position = c(0.48, 0.7),
  legend.direction = "horizontal")+
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 7, barheight = 1,
                title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_x_discrete(
        labels=greekLab)  +
  scale_y_discrete(
        labels=greekLab)


```


# MLMs of Value Estimates Predicting Trial-by-Trial Self-Evaluations

Value estimates moderately predict trial-by-trial self-evaluations, but moreso when interacting with trials. Oddly, at later trials, value estimates are less predictive of self-evaluations.

```{r}
# Null model
m1 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ 1 + ( 1 | subID ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# SE as Random Intercept
m2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + ( 1 | subID ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# LRT
anova(m2, m1)
# Rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m2)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[2]

# SE as random slope for subject
m3 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + ( scale(valEst) | subID ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
summary(m3)

# LRT
anova(m3, m2)
# Rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m3)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[2]

# Trait as random factor
m4 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + ( scale(valEst) | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
summary(m4)

# LRT
anova(m4, m3)
# rsqdiff
r.squaredGLMM(m4)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m4)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m3)[2]

# Remove NA values for LRTs because models can't be compared if not fit to same data
tbtNeigh2 <- tbtNeigh[!is.na(tbtNeigh$T1averageAllPE),]
# Alternative model 4 for LRT
m4.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + ( scale(valEst) | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# Include neighbors' outdegree PEs
m5<- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE) + ( scale(valEst) | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# Alternative model for LRT
m5.2<- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE) + ( scale(valEst) | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
summary(m5)
anova(m5.2, m4.2)
r.squaredGLMM(m5.2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m4.2)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m5.2)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m4.2)[2]

# Include random slope for neighbor PEs
m6<- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE) + ( scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE) | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# Alternative model for LRT
m6.2<- lmer(scale(selfRespT1) ~ scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE) + ( scale(valEst) + scale(T1averageAllPE)  | subID ) + (1 | Trait ), data = tbtNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
summary(m6)
anova(m6.2, m5.2)
r.squaredGLMM(m6.2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m5.2)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m6.2)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m5.2)[2]
confint(m6)
```

# MLMs of Value Estimates Predicting Re-Evaluations

```{r}
# dataset with NAs removed
rDf <- na.omit(fullTDdf)
# Null Model 
m0 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ 1 + (1 |subID), data = rDf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)


# Base Residualized Change Model (T1 predicting T2)
m1.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + (1 |subID), data = rDf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m1.2, m0)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m1.2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m0)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m1.2)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m0)[2]
m1 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# Prediction Error Main Effect Model
m2F <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(predError) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2F, m1)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2F)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m2F)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[2]
# Social Expectation Main Effect Model
m2V <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# LRT
anova(m2V, m1)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2V)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m2V)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[2]
# Prediction Error and Social Expectation Model
m2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2, m2V)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2F)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m2)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2F)[2]
# Prediction Error, Social Expectation, and Indegree and Outdegree Centrality Model
m2IO <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(inDegree) + scale(outDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2IO, m2)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[2]
# Prediction Error Interacting with Outdegree Model
m3FO <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(inDegree) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2IO, m3FO)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3FO)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m3FO)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[2]
# Prediction Error Interacting with Indegree Model
m3FI <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(outDegree) + scale(predError)*scale(inDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2IO, m3FI)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3FI)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m3FI)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[2]
# Social Expectation Interacting with Outdegree Model
m3VO <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(inDegree) + scale(valEstF)*scale(outDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2IO, m3VO)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3VO)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m3VO)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[2]
# Social Expectation Interacting with Indegree Model
m3VI <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(outDegree) + scale(valEstF)*scale(inDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2IO, m3VI)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3VI)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[1]
r.squaredGLMM(m3VI)[2] - r.squaredGLMM(m2IO)[2]
# Social Expectation Interacting with Indegree and Prediction Error Interacting with Outdegree Model
m3 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError) + scale(valEstF)*scale(inDegree) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + (1 |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m3,m3FO)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m3FO)[1]

# Introducing random slope for social expectaton
ZreEvalModelV <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + scale(inDegree) + scale(valEstF):scale(inDegree) + ( scale(valEstF) |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m3,ZreEvalModelV)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(ZreEvalModelV)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1]

# Introducing random slope for prediction error
ZreEvalModelF <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + scale(inDegree) + scale(valEstF):scale(inDegree) + ( scale(predError) |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m3,ZreEvalModelF)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(ZreEvalModelF)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1]

# Introducing random slopes for both prediction error and social expectation
ZreEvalModelB <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + scale(inDegree) + scale(valEstF):scale(inDegree) + ( scale(predError) + scale(valEstF) |subID), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m3,ZreEvalModelB)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(ZreEvalModelB)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1]

# Introducing trait as a random factor
ZreEvalModelFinal <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(selfRespT1) + scale(valEstF) + scale(predError)*scale(outDegree) + scale(inDegree) + scale(valEstF):scale(inDegree) + ( scale(predError) + scale(valEstF) |subID) + ( 1 | Trait), data = fullTDdf, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
anova(ZreEvalModelFinal, ZreEvalModelB)
r.squaredGLMM(ZreEvalModelFinal)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(ZreEvalModelB)[1]

summary(ZreEvalModelFinal)

# all effect sizes
b<-r2beta(ZreEvalModelFinal)
data.frame(b$Effect, b$Rsq)
# confidence intervals
confint(ZreEvalModelFinal)
```

# Neighbors Reevaluation Model

```{r}
# create dataframe for LRTs so dataset is same size for model comparison
reEvalNeigh2 <- reEvalNeigh[!is.na(reEvalNeigh$T2averageOutPE),]
reEvalNeigh2 <- reEvalNeigh2[!is.na(reEvalNeigh2$T2averageInPE),]

# Null Intercept Only Model
m1 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ 1 + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# Alternative model for LRT
m1.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ 1 + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)

# Indegree-connected PE neighbors main effect
m2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
m2.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m2.2,m1.2)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m2.2)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m1)[1]

# Outdegree-connected PE neighbors main effect
m3 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
m3.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m3.2,m2.2)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m3)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1]

# Outdegree and indegree connected PE neighbors main effects; fixed slopes
m4 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
m4.2 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( 1 | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh2, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m4.2,m2.2)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m4)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m2)[1]

# Indegree connected PE neighbors as random slope
m5 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( scale(T2averageInPE) | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m5,m4)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m5)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m4)[1]

# Outdegree connected PE neighbors as random slope
m6 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( scale(T2averageOutPE) | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m6,m4)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m6)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m4)[1]

# Both PE neighbors as random slopes
m7 <- lmer(scale(selfRespT2) ~ scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) + ( scale(T2averageInPE) + scale(T2averageOutPE) | subID ) + ( 1 | Trait), data = reEvalNeigh, 
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl = list(maxfun=2e5)), REML = FALSE)
# LRT
anova(m7,m4)
# rsq diff
r.squaredGLMM(m7)[1] - r.squaredGLMM(m4)[1]
summary(m7)

# effect sizes
b<-r2beta(m7)
data.frame(b$Effect, b$Rsq)
# confidence intervals
#confint(m5)
```

## predError by Outdegree Interaction Plot

```{r}
reEvalModel <- lmer(selfRespT2 ~ selfRespT1 + valEstF + predError*outDegree + inDegree + valEstF:inDegree + ( valEstF + predError |subID) + ( 1 |Trait), data = fullTDdf,
```

```{r}

plotOUTPE<-ggplot(p, aes(x, predicted)) +  geom_line(aes(linetype=group, color=group)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high, fill=group), alpha=0.15) + scale_linetype_discrete(labels = c("Low PE","Mid PE", "High PE")) + scale_color_discrete(labels = c("Low PE","Mid PE", "High PE")) + scale_fill_discrete(

    legend.box.just = "left",

    ) + theme(axis.text=element_text(size=9),
        axis.title=element_text(size=9,face="bold")) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size=9)) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size =1)) + theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  xlab("Outdegree Centrality") + ylab("T2 Self-Evaluation")
```

### FDR Correction

```{r}
#df<-AsymLR.corDf[c(2,10:ncol(AsymLR.corDf))]
df<-AsymLR.corDf[c("posLR","Status","RS","MAIA.All","LSA","SM","BDI","SCC","SING.Ind","SING.Inter","DS","SE","BF.EXT","BF.AGR","BF.CON","BF.OPE","BF.NEG")]
res2 <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(df))
pcol<-as.data.frame(res2$P)[1]
padj<-p.adjust(as.numeric(unlist(pcol)), method = "fdr", n = nrow(pcol)-1)
PLR_pcol<-cbind(pcol, data.frame(padj))
PLR_pcol
```

### Create panel of scatterplots for associations below <.05

```{r}
# RS, LSA, BDI, SCC, SE, CON, NEG, EXT
varNames<-c("RS","LSA","BDI","SCC","SE","DS","BF.EXT","BF.CON","BF.NEG")
varLabels<-c("Reject. Sensit.", "Social Anxiety", "Depressive Symp.", "Self-Concept Clarity", "Self-Esteem","Dialectical Self", "Extraversion", "Conscientiousness", "Neuroticism")

for(i in 1:length(varNames)){
  varCol<-AsymLR.corDf[varNames[i]]
  corDf <- data.frame(LR=AsymLR.corDf$posLR, ind=as.numeric(unlist(varCol[1])))
  scatter <- ggplot(corDf, aes(x=ind, y=LR)) + ylim(0,1) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method=lm, se=T, colour="black") + xlab(varLabels[i]) + ylab("Positive Learning Rate")  + theme_apa() + theme(text = element_text(size=10), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face="bold"), axis.title.y=element_blank())
  scatter
  name<-paste0(varNames[i],"_plot")
  assign(name,scatter)
}


```

```{r}
ggpubr::ggarrange(RS_plot, LSA_plot, BDI_plot, SCC_plot, SE_plot, DS_plot, BF.EXT_plot, BF.CON_plot, BF.NEG_plot,

ggsave("scatters.jpg", units = "in", dpi = 600, width = 7.5, height = 4)
```
